title: The Felted Ball in the Soapy Basin
youtube_title: The Felted Ball in the Soapy Basin | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Leaving a cover on is a kind of trust.
summary: At a quiet craft corner with paper, paste, and a wooden rack, Ximena wants to check on a wool ball felting in a soapy basin before it is ready. With Auntie Luz nearby, Ximena leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
